style:
Create ONE finished wide landscape image: a character turnaround consisting of exactly THREE full-body depictions of the SAME character, left strict FRONT view, middle strict RIGHT-SIDE profile (nose points right), right strict BACK view. Equal scale, identical costume and proportions, same standing pose rotated in place, soles aligned, generous plain WHITE negative space separating figures. No text, labels, borders, ground, cast shadows or watermarks. Only this one character design, no other characters or pets. This specific request for a three-view turnaround overrides the generic negative "turnaround sheet" and generic single 3/4 view language.

Use the provided Ice Cream video stills as the visual rendering reference: handmade early-2000s Japanese game asset, crude real-time Dreamcast/PS1 3D, very simple few-polygon primitive forms, slightly awkward appealing proportions. Deep solid 3D heads, ears and hair, NOT flat illustration. Narrow VERY SHORT torso, high pelvis, conspicuously long thighs AND calves, about 6 to 6.5 heads tall, delicate but volumetric arms and hands. Oversized shoes much longer and wider than the actual feet, super thick soles. Rounded overall silhouette made with a few chunky wedge/box/4–6 sided forms, subtle large faceted planes. Sparse low-resolution hand-painted pixel facial features on a 3D face; deliberately uneven chunky pixels, asymmetric eyelids, small mouth and nose, minimal black eyebrows. Relaxed, delinquent, antisocial STREET attitude and highly individual character. Limited dusty pastel vertex colors; flat unlit MATTE planes, no surface texture or noise. Render as if low native resolution around 480px height then nearest-neighbor enlarged; unmistakable blocky silhouette stair-steps and face pixels. Clean solid color areas, absolutely no glossy toy look, no studio lighting, no AO, no soft shading or realistic shadows.

Do not copy the blue-haired character or costume from the reference. The design below is mandatory. Keep the three views consistent and readable while showing the character's rebellious signature posture and exaggerated face. Camera stays level with no foreshortening for these three useful views. No carried weapons or loose props; only explicitly specified worn costume accessories. Nonsexual adolescent streetwear.

AVOID photorealism, polished designer toy, smooth vinyl doll, clay, plush, metal reflections, realistic lighting, detailed fabric, hair strands, intricate parts, dense triangular facets, crystalline geometry, voxel art, normal realistic human facial anatomy, generic emoji, perfect symmetry, glossy anime eyes, sparkles, high-resolution smooth edges, cinematic effects, scenery, text.

characters.name: Jax
characters.prompt:
JAX, 17-year-old boy, tall lean light warm beige skin #E9CBB5. His signature is feral, mischievous delighted aggression: crooked wide tooth-baring cackle, one eyebrow compressed, eyes looking arrogantly slightly aside under hat, NO friendly smile. Lean forward a little from hips, knees slack, shoulders cocky and hands loose with slightly splayed fingers. Keep full height legible, arms separated from body.

Low pulled-down INK NAVY beanie #292D3B covering upper forehead and half the ears. Thick black-brown #302D2B wedge hair spikes burst sideways and out the BACK under the cap, not spiky hair on top of cap. Each ear has a simple small matte grey hoop. One heavy chunky necklace of just a FEW big blunt matte iron-grey #9AA3AD links, clearly separated from chin and shirt, no shine.

NARROW SHORT torso, coral brick #CC6657 loose short-sleeve T-shirt OVER warm chalk-white #E7DFC9 long-sleeve shirt. BOTH white sleeves reach wrists, BOTH coral sleeves stop equally at upper arms. Small white underlayer neck/hem edges. Very wide straight-leg navy cargo pants, exceptionally wide lower openings, one flat pocket on character's LEFT thigh only. Pants cover much of huge shoes. Shoes warm white, very long very wide blunt SQUARE toe, single broad fastening strap where visible, small muted teal #35676B heel patch and outrageously thick flat navy sole. Shoe toes and heavy soles visibly protrude below pants. Legs genuinely long inside pants, not just high shoe soles. Show beanie rear, spikes rear, necklace around neck, and the single pocket consistently across front/right/back.

characters.name: Vee
characters.prompt:
VEE, 17-year-old girl, lean pale cool pink skin #F0DCD1. Ice-cold, aloof, judgmental, hates smiling. Heavy half-lidded long eyes, asymmetrical low brows, narrow straight firmly closed mouth, piercing sideways scrutinizing grey-blue gaze #536D90. NO SMILE, no blush, no friendly expression. Upright narrow torso with sharp controlled slightly offset hip/shoulder posture, chin slightly tucked, one palm turned outward in a minimal dismissive gesture but arms separated to reveal outfit. Her defiance is precise and impatient.

MINT GREEN #75C7B0 simple deep hair shell, thick diagonal wedge fringe and one longer side lock ending in an outward flick; back of skull fully covered with thick hair volume. Asymmetric headphones: character LEFT ear warm white disc with a small missing wedge; RIGHT ear navy rectangular box, lavender accent centers, simple headband with a gap from hair. No decorative tiny tech detail.

Warm chalk-white #E7DFC9 SLEEVELESS cropped crewneck street top, ordinary broad shoulder straps and loose straight fit, one simple flat pale lavender #9B8ACC circle on chest and broad lavender hem band. Narrow short upper body, genuinely long legs. High waist cool mist grey #BCC5D4 trousers slightly controlled above knees then exceptionally wide FLARED bell-bottom lower legs, NO cargo pockets. Hems drape substantially over shoes. Enormous pale lavender rounded-square slip-on shoes with tiny white front panel, extremely thick continuous platform soles and navy bottom band. Toe ends and platforms remain visible. Small lavender interface on left wrist and minimal navy right fingerless glove. Do NOT carry a gun: unobstructed costume study, no held props.

characters.name: Skye
characters.prompt:
SKYE, 16-year-old girl, slim light peach skin #EBC8B8. Relaxed cute but deceitful troublemaker, clever mischievous antisocial prankster. Half-drooped large cartoon eye shapes with sharply crooked brow, pupils sliding sideways #71502D and small sly one-corner-up mouth, expression "you fell for it". Absolutely NO sparkling eyes, no eye highlights, no eyelashes, no innocent sunny grin. Lazy hip tilt, one knee slack, elbows casually slightly out from waist, one small hand held in loose casual two-finger mocking gesture below shoulder. Same recognizable stance rotated in the three views; no sexualized pose.

Dark chestnut #533C3D thick simple hair cap, short thick FAN-SHAPED ponytail, a single bent cowlick on forehead. Hair solids genuinely thick in side/back.

Narrow short torso, long thin volumetric limbs, muted teal #35676B SLEEVELESS VERY SHORT cropped everyday crewneck tank, ordinary broad straps, straight hem, tiny simple white geometric mark, naturally visible waist. No jacket, no T-shirt layer. Very wide opening SHORT navy #292D3B shorts, loose complete shorts silhouette. Navy thigh-high socks reach mid-thigh with a gap of bare thigh below shorts; exactly THREE broad warm white #E7DFC9 horizontal stripes concentrated ABOVE knee on BOTH socks, equally aligned, wrap continuously around side and rear, pure navy BELOW knees.

Extraordinarily big long wide warm white upturned-toe running shoes, coral #CC6657 short heel block, separate absurdly thick navy forefoot and heel sole blocks, clear arched midfoot gap. Shoes genuinely enormous in all three views. Simple diagonal navy bag strap from character RIGHT shoulder to LEFT rear hip; small flat navy box bag with coral triangular flap and white square buckle, back/side visible, never blocks waist. No held weapon or extra props.

characters.name: Niko
characters.prompt:
NIKO, 16-year-old boy, lean pale neutral beige skin #E5D2BC. Sinister, controlling, quietly contemptuous, fascinated by commanding machines. Neck drawn in, shoulders slightly rounded inward, head tilted subtly DOWN but still see face shape, closed tight small mouth with a barely upturned disdainful one-sided corner, NOT a happy child, no spaced-out open mouth. Elbows close to body without obscuring torso, fingers of one hand held in a short precise clawlike command at waist height. Stance a little rigid with narrow upper body and long legs, readable same pose in each view.

INK NAVY #292D3B layered mushroom-shaped thick hair, three staggered blunt thick fringe wedges, short earlobe and nape layers; NOT a flat one-level bowl-cut. Warm white #E7DFC9 flat octagonal TWO-WINDOW goggles worn OVER eyes, thick navy strap around back of head. Smoked grey-olive #8C9871 tinted lenses: upper section SOLID darker olive, lower section one lighter flat color with eyes only vaguely visible. No gradients, no reflections, not clear glass. Separate hair/goggle/strap/hood volumes.

Dusty blue periwinkle #859AC1 ZIP hoodie with a narrow SHORT body, warm white undershirt. Both roomy sleeves equally rolled to just BELOW elbows, broad simple cuffs. Hood DOWN behind neck and separate from hair. Very wide grey olive #8C9871 cropped trousers ending around mid-calf, very wide loose openings NOT gathered. White short socks. Huge exaggerated round-toed deep-opening slip-on shoes, warm white with one broad dusty periwinkle instep panel and enormously thick blunt one-piece navy sole; truly long wide bulbous shoes.

One SMALL flip-open L-shaped remote controller attached at character LEFT waist, navy base and white lid, exactly one acid-yellow #D6D573 large round button and a couple white block buttons. It stays attached, does not hide hands/outfit. No robot, no companion, no gun, no loose props. Show layered rear hair, goggle rear strap and hanging hood clearly separated.
